response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive full-stack experience with a strong alignment to the required stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB) and additional proficiency in Kotlin/Java for backend services. His roles at Optilyz and re:cinq highlight direct experience with scaling systems and AI-agent infrastructure, while his open-source contributions and leadership in workshops reflect deep technical expertise and collaboration skills. Minor concerns include limited explicit mention of Nest.js and Vitest, though his adaptability suggests quick learning.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (14+ years) with modern stacks (TypeScript/Node.js/React) and polyglot expertise (Java/Kotlin, D, C++).
Proven track record in scaling systems (handling millions of HTTP requests/sec at dunnhumby, optimizing pricing strategies at Optilyz).
Strong leadership in open-source projects, workshops, and mentorship, demonstrating technical depth and collaboration.
concerns: Limited explicit mention of Nest.js (primary stack requirement), though Node.js experience suggests adaptability.
No direct experience with Vitest (testing framework) mentioned, though Jest expertise implies familiarity.
Portfolio includes older technologies (e.g., Ember.js, Dlang), which may not reflect current best practices in the target role.
